name: makeplane
description: Official Plane plugins for Claude Code: work with your Plane workspace, and deploy and run self-hosted Plane.

plugins.name: plane
plugins.description: Work with your Plane Cloud workspace from Claude Code through Plane's hosted MCP server: work items, cycles, modules, intake, pages and more.

plugins.name: plane-self-hosting
plugins.description: Deploy, upgrade and troubleshoot self-hosted Plane (Community or Commercial) on your own infrastructure: Docker AIO, Docker Compose, prime-cli, Kubernetes, Podman, Swarm, Portainer, Coolify or air-gapped. Claude probes your infrastructure, asks which method and add-ons you want, then installs and verifies.
